features.title: What the Cutting Assistant does
features.subtitle: AI-assisted cutting edge optimization — purpose-built for your 2D TRUMPF laser cutting machine.

items.title: Dialog-Guided Optimization
items.desc: Even inexperienced users can optimize cutting data like a pro in just a few minutes. The step-by-step dialog guides you through the entire process — saving time and material costs.

items.title: Handheld Scanner Assessment
items.desc: Scan the cutting edge objectively with the handheld scanner. The Cutting Assistant displays roughness and burr height in micrometers for an accurate, reproducible quality assessment.

items.title: AI Mode (from March 2026)
items.desc: AI-generated parameter recommendations based on your specific cutting issue and material. Currently available for Mild Steel (N₂, O₂) and Stainless Steel (N₂) on Highspeed and MD5 machines.

items.title: Bandwidth Mode
items.desc: Cut a series of test parts across the full parameter range. Suitable for all materials and for cutting issues where the cutting edge cannot be scanned. Available now across the complete process range.

items.title: Non-Standard Material Support
items.desc: Excellent cutting quality even in non-laser-grade material. The Cutting Assistant suggests suitable optimizations for special materials or materials with fluctuating quality grades.

items.title: Laser Technology Table (LTT)
items.desc: Built on TRUMPF's proven cutting parameters from the Laser Technology Table. Select your specific cutting issue — burrs, roughness, or beam interruption — as the starting point for optimization.

operator.title: Built for the shop floor.
operator.subtitle: Three guided steps — from scanning the cut edge to applying optimized parameters.

steps.title: Scan the cutting edge
steps.desc: Use the handheld scanner to capture an objective measurement of the cutting edge. The Cutting Assistant displays roughness and burr height in micrometers.

steps.title: Select your cutting issue
steps.desc: Choose your specific cutting issue from the Laser Technology Table — burrs, roughness, beam interruption, and more. The system identifies the right starting parameters.

steps.title: Choose your optimization mode
steps.desc: Use AI mode for direct parameter recommendations (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel — from March 2026), or Bandwidth mode to cut a test series across the full parameter range.

steps.title: Apply and confirm
steps.desc: Apply the optimized parameters directly to the machine software — no manual reprogramming required. Verify the result with the scanner and repeat the cycle until the desired cut quality is achieved.

operator.q: Which machines does the Cutting Assistant support?
operator.a: The Cutting Assistant is designed for TRUMPF 2D laser cutting machines. AI mode is available for the Highspeed and MD5 series. Bandwidth mode is available across the full process range.

operator.q: What is the difference between AI mode and Bandwidth mode?
operator.a: AI mode uses an AI model to recommend parameter adjustments based on burr and roughness measurements — available from March 2026 for Mild Steel (N₂, O₂) and Stainless Steel (N₂). Bandwidth mode cuts a series of test parts across a parameter range and is available now for all materials including Aluminum.

operator.q: Which materials does AI mode support?
operator.a: AI mode currently supports Mild Steel with Nitrogen, Mild Steel with Oxygen, and Stainless Steel with Nitrogen on Highspeed and MD5 machines. Aluminum, Copper, Brass, and other materials are handled via Bandwidth mode.

operator.q: Do I need experience to use the Cutting Assistant?
operator.a: No. The dialog-guided process is designed so that even inexperienced users can optimize cutting data like a pro in just a few minutes. The system guides you step by step through scanning, issue selection, and parameter optimization.

operator.q: What does the handheld scanner measure?
operator.a: The handheld scanner provides an objective assessment of the cutting edge — displaying roughness and burr height in micrometers. This replaces subjective visual inspection with reproducible, measurable quality data.

management.q: When will AI mode be available?
management.a: AI mode is available from March 2026 for Mild Steel (N₂, O₂) and Stainless Steel (N₂) on Highspeed and MD5 machines. Bandwidth mode is available now and covers the complete process range including Aluminum.
The Cutting Assistant runs on the TRUMPF machine. In addition, the handheld scanner is required for scanning the cutting edge as part of the optimization workflow.

management.q: Which materials and gases are supported in Bandwidth mode?
management.a: Bandwidth mode supports the complete process range: Mild Steel (Nitrogen, Mixed Gas, Oxygen, Air), Stainless Steel (Nitrogen), and Aluminum (Nitrogen, Gasmix, Oxygen, Air). It is also suitable for cutting issues where the cutting edge cannot be scanned.

management.q: Can operators without laser expertise use this system?
management.a: Yes. The dialog-guided process is specifically designed for users without deep laser expertise. The system guides them through each step — from scanning to issue selection to parameter adjustment.

management.q: Can the Cutting Assistant be retrofitted to existing machines?
management.a: The Cutting Assistant is available for many machines in the TruLaser series and can typically be retrofitted to existing equipment — protecting your investment in the machine park.

management.q: How does the Cutting Assistant fit into a connected production environment?
management.a: Combined with TRUMPF's Oseon software, the Cutting Assistant integrates into a Smart Factory environment. Oseon provides centralized control and analysis of your entire production — including material flow, machine utilization, and optimization potential — enabling truly data-driven process management.

management.q: Where can I see the Cutting Assistant in action?
management.a: A product video is available at https://www.trumpf.info/fsbpmj. You can also request a live demonstration at any TRUMPF showroom. Contact TRUMPF Machine Tools Germany Sales + Service GmbH + Co. KG for details.
